this_title: Vida y la torta de chocolate
introduction: During the afternoon, Vida and her mother cook a chocolate cake together. During the night, this happy memory turns into recurring nightmares when the cake tries to devour Vida in her dreams. Not even Hugo's company, a stuffed mummy made by Vida as an amulet, will help the girl. Her mother will have the craziest ideas for Vida to find the heroin she has inside. With the help of imaginary powers, Vida will embark on a brave journey into her dreams to fight her night terrors. A magical event will prompt her to discover that the key to overcoming her fears was always within her.
